description: This file defines the MultipartUploadException class within the Aws\Exception namespace. It extends RuntimeException and implements MonitoringEventsInterface, representing an exception specifically for multipart upload errors in the AWS SDK for PHP. The class encapsulates information about the upload state and constructs detailed error messages based on the context of the error, including handling previous exceptions and error details for each failed part.

classes.name: MultipartUploadException
classes.description: Represents an exception that occurs during a multipart upload process in AWS SDK for PHP. It includes the upload state at the time of the error and constructs detailed messages based on previous errors and operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a new MultipartUploadException, generating an appropriate error message based on the previous exception(s) and upload state.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the UploadState object representing the state of the transfer at the time of the exception.
